The '''E-9 ''Explorer''-class armed long range scout vessel''' was a [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] produced by the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] that required a small crew to operate at peak efficiency.

==Characteristics==
[[File:e-9.jpg|thumb|left|200px]]
The [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar]] E-9 Explorer was a long-range scout vessel. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] stations that allowed the four-person crew to monitor and operate the E-9's systems. The crew quarters were located along the neck of the ship, and were large enough to be comfortable on long voyages for both the vessel's crew and up to four passengers; the crew and passengers could also avail themselves of a ship's lounge that had an [[autochef]] system, a [[Hologame table/Legends|hologame table]], and other entertainment facilities. The main body of the ship held an [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] section and a three-deck [[cargo bay]]; this bay could hold a small [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle, which could exit the ship through a ventral cargo elevator.<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

A network of [[crawlway]]s was built under the main deck that could reach almost any part of the ship, giving [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] easy access to ship's systems during flight. However, the only entry/exit point was through the [[gunwell]] in the fore of the cargo bay; entering the maintenance tunnels anywhere else would require cutting through the deck plating.<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

The E-9 Explorer's armament consisted of two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], one above and one below the ship's main hull. The designers believed this armament would provide sufficient defense, but owners of E-9s found that the weapon systems were easy to upgrade, and often opted to install [[Laser cannon|double]], [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad]], or [[Heavy laser cannon/Legends|heavy]] laser cannons in their stead; some even installed a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] into the underside of the ship's nose. Such modifications were viewed by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] as unnecessary at best, and in some cases deemed sufficient cause for the Empire to seize a ship so modified.<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

==History==
Loronar introduced the E-9 Explorer towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as an unarmored [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. In the face of tumultuous political times and the increasing market share of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation's]] successful line of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], the E-9 was only able to achieve mild success. Loronar maintained support for the ship with the expectation that sales would improve, though they nearly discontinued the ship several times in the ensuing years. When Loronar followed the lead of other starship manufacturers and began weaponizing its offerings, the E-9 was one of the first to receive this treatment, and the change and subsequent advertising promotion raised sales figures and ensured the ship's survival.<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

However, soon afterward, the Empire began cracking down on manufacturers that were adding armaments to their ships. Loronar pleaded with the [[Imperial Bureau of Shipyards and Construction]] and began a string of legal battles that again put E-9 production in jeopardy. Ultimately, Loronar secured permission to continue selling the vessel as an armed transport intended as an exploration vessel, justifying the ship's weapon loadout as required to defend itself away from Imperial protection.<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

Given a new direction by this justification, Loronar upgraded the ship's [[Starship sensor array|sensor suite]] and changed its marketing strategy. Although sales suffered somewhat, Loronar chose not to shy away from the good fortune of avoiding an Imperial production stoppage, and continued supporting the E-9 until several years after the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

==E-9 Explorers in the galaxy==
E-9 Explorers were most often encountered in unexplored [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] or in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] far removed from populous regions like the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], in the hands of rugged crews of [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] seeking new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and secrets. Other groups operating E-9 Explorers were small [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] bands, using it as their primary mode of transportation; [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], employing it to loot [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and luxury transports; and merchants and wealthy individuals, who occasionally adopted E-9s as personal [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]].<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The E-9 Explorer originated on the website [http://www.swrpgnetwork.com SWRPGNetwork] before [[Wizards of the Coast]] canonized it in the ''[[Message to Spacers]]'' series of web articles.
